messages:
maya: Quick note: we finished Orpheus9b bench. Need a one-paragraph GTN recommendation: int8 default vs int4 opt-in routing, plus a tiny flag snippet.

diego: Smoke numbers (25k tokens): p95 int8=122ms, int4=110ms; unit cost est int8 ~$0.0009/tok, int4 ~$0.0006/tok.

lina-qa: QA snapshot: longform QA (>512) EM drops ~6.4pts int8->int4, hallucination +2.1ppt. Short snippets (<=64) EM delta <1pt.

sam: Short GTN rec: default to int8 for high-value/longform routes; enable int4 opt-in for short, low-risk flows to capture ~25-35% unit-cost savings. Canary int4 at 5% on targeted slices.

aj: Ops caveat: enable KV-cache warmstarts for priming-heavy routes to reduce effective token spend and narrow recall gap. If quality gap persists, consider a small mixed-per-layer quant trial.

diego: Tiny routing flag (proto): `routes=[{match:"tokens<=64 && flow=='low_cost'",model:"orpheus9b-int4",sample:0.05},{model:"orpheus9b-int8",sample:0.95}] fallbacks=[{from:"orpheus9b-int4",to:"orpheus9b-int8",triggers:["quality_drop","latency_spike"]}]`

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled 2h canary on eng-dedicated-orpheus tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Auto-rollback if >2% EM regression on any primary slice or >20% p95 latency increase.

maya: Action items: sam write GTN blurb, diego open routing PR, lina run canary slices and post CSV. I'll monitor and call rollback if thresholds trip. Thanks all :thumbsup:
